text:
marta: Drafting release note for tonight's EU canary. Need ops + legal signoff before internal blast.

marta: RN draft: "KV cache warmup reduces cold-start token latency ~30% (p95). Model pinned to v2.1.3 for canary with fallback to v2.0.9. SDK auth-header change is opt-in behind feature flag. Private EU customers: data processed in-region per residency settings."

devansh: RN bullets: kv warmup + metrics, model pin v2.1.3 (fallback v2.0.9), perf numbers, sdk opt-in note.

kai: Ops: propose rollback if error rate >1.5% for 5m OR p95 >1500ms for 3m. Start canary at 5% traffic, hold 10m, ramp to 20% if healthy.

lia: Legal: add EU data residency sentence and I'll sign off.

devansh: Deploy command: `/deploy canary eu-1 --pin model:v2.1.3 --tag rn-2026-04-02 --traffic 5%` Alerts -> canary-errors@pager + #infra.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rn-2026-04-02 canary for eu-1 at 2026-04-02T00:30:00Z; queued by marta. Reply "ACK" to confirm standby.

devansh: ACK, monitoring + alerts configured.

kai: SGTM, I'll run the ramp at +10m and annotate checklist.

marta: Internal blurb to post ~30m before: suggestion?

devansh: One-liner: "Canary rn-2026-04-02: model v2.1.3 -> 5% EU, ramp to 20% if healthy. Oncall: infra/devansh, eng/kai. Rollback if >1.5% errors or p95 >1500ms."

kai: Good.

devansh: Ops playbook emergency fallback: `/deploy set-traffic eu-1 0% --target model:v2.0.9 --reason "canary rollback"`. Include rollback doc in playbook.

marta: Everyone OK with RN and blurb?

kai: OK eng.

devansh: OK infra.

lia: Legal approved.

marta: Great 680 4aa scheduling pre-flight ping and will queue deploy-bot 30m prior."
